paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.6, with a change of -13.16% compared to the prior close and -2.08% over a window of 23 sessions. There have been 13 new news articles in the last 24 hours.

Fermi reported a second quarter net loss and a larger six-month loss, which has put recent sentiment under pressure.
